g.text: Full loop through the client bridge (scenario 1: art_03 vs BD Plastipak Luer-Lok 10 ml, 300912)
Log in, exchange token, sync templates
rate limit; sign assertion+jwt (node private key);
verify kid, signature, aud, exp, jti unused;
GET /templates; PUT /templates {definition} if the hub's is newer
["this is our current product" on the Injekt row]
claim ASSESS; requirement attributes vs variant
(409 on stale version or open purchaser questions)
freeze answers; typed values -> SUPPLIER_ANSWER facts;
Resolve (the verdict stays at the hub)
Assessment list (any purchaser of the hospital)
On 401 from the hub (token expired) the client repeats the assertion and the token exchange.
The node and the hub never exchange a single request directly. Hub assertions are the only signed object (D52).
